examples.en: He poured water into the small pot.
Coffee is brewed in a small pot.
Take a shovel and dig.
We clear the snow with a shovel.
It hurts between my shoulder blades.
Massage helps with shoulder blade pain.
He uses lotion after shaving.
I bought a face lotion.
Take the watermelon to the picnic.
In the summer we eat cold watermelon.
They partied the whole weekend.
I don't like to party until dawn.
Look at the small print with a magnifying glass.
The collector uses a magnifying glass.

examples.sr: Немој да [лупѐташ], то уопште није истина!
examples.en: Don't talk nonsense, that's not true at all!
Don't listen to him, he's just talking nonsense.
A big chandelier hangs in the living room.
Turn on the chandelier, it's dark.
She has a master's degree in economics.
My brother has a master's degree in pharmacy.
She got her master's degree in 2017.
I want to get my master's degree at the Faculty of Philology.
Turn on the fog lights, the fog is thick.
One fog light isn't working.
The morning is foggy.
It's foggy on the road.
It's foggy this morning.
When it's foggy, we drive more slowly.
My dog is a real cuddler.

examples.sr: Дете је [ма̏за] и стално тражи загрљај.
examples.en: The child is very affectionate and keeps asking for a hug.

note: Of a child, an animal, or anyone affectionate.

examples.en: Grandma loves to pamper her grandchildren.
The cat likes it when she is petted.

tips: A verb of tenderness: to caress, to pamper children, grandchildren, pets. Not to be confused with «мазати» - to smear, to spread.

examples.en: The child is cuddling with her mom.
The cat loves to be cuddled.

note: Not to be confused with «мазати» - to smear (cream).

examples.en: Poppy seed cake is my favorite.
A red poppy was blooming among the wheat.
I'm making macaroni and cheese tonight.
Boil the pasta for ten minutes.
With a fever, I get hit by listlessness.
Fever and weakness are the first symptoms.

examples.sr: Мачак је [мала̏ксао] и цео дан спава.
examples.en: The tomcat is listless and sleeps all day.
She was exhausted after the flu.
I'm completely worn out from the heat.
When I catch a cold, I lose my strength right away.
Green malachite is used for jewelry.

examples.sr: На изложби смо видели вазу од [мала̀хита].
examples.en: At the exhibition we saw a vase made of malachite.
Bad luck is following me around today.
What a disaster, I lost my keys!
Raspberry jam is my favorite.
Grandma picks raspberries in the garden.
What a cute little guy you are!
The little boy has learned to walk.
He was dejected after the defeat.

examples.sr: Не буди [мало̀душан], све ће бити у реду.
examples.en: Don't be downhearted, everything will be fine.
He wrote almost a whole novel.
I was almost late.
The wall is covered with fresh plaster.
We're mixing mortar in a bucket.
Sellers lure customers with low prices.
The fisherman lures fish with worms.

tips: The perfective forms are «намамити» (to lure in) and «измамити» (to coax out): «Измамило га је сунце» - the sun coaxed him out. «Мамац» is bait.

examples.en: This morning I'm hungover after the party.
He looks rumpled after the slava (the family saint's day feast).
This morning I have a terrible hangover.
Coffee doesn't help me with a hangover.

examples.sr: Тај [ма̀нгуп] је опет побегао са часа.
examples.en: That rascal skipped class again.
The little scamp broke the window.
We always buy tangerines for the holidays.
The kids ate a whole tangerine.
She works as a fashion model in Milan.

examples.sr: Моја сестра је у младости била [манѐке̄нка].
examples.en: My sister was a fashion model in her youth.
I'm going for a manicure today.
How much does a manicure cost?

meanings: to drop, to leave alone (a topic, an activity)

examples.en: Drop it, it's not worth the effort.
Let's drop the idle talk.

note: Takes the genitive; mostly in the imperative: «мани се», «манимо се».

examples.sr: У коктел сам додала сок од [мараку̀је].
examples.en: I added passion fruit juice to the cocktail.
Passion fruit is tart and fragrant.
Grandma wears a scarf on her head.
She tied a scarf around her neck.
There is a bouquet of daisies in the vase.
I got a daisy for my birthday.

note: The wild chamomile daisy is «бела рада» (literally "white joy").

examples.en: The cake needs 200 grams of margarine.
My mother always buys butter instead of margarine.
The meat needs to marinate all night.
Yesterday I marinated the chicken.
The police van came and took them away.
The police put them in the van.
I sketched the route of the trip on paper.
This route goes past the lake.
She is a diligent student.
He is as hardworking as an ant.
He studies diligently every day.
She worked diligently all year.
I have oily hair.
I don't eat fatty food.

examples.sr: Леђа ме боле, па идем код [масе́ра].
examples.en: My back hurts, so I'm going to see a masseur.
This masseur has magic hands.
I bought a new mascara.
This mascara is waterproof.

examples.sr: На [маскѐнбалу] сам била обучена као вила.
examples.en: At the masquerade I was dressed as a fairy.
The school is organizing a costume party for Halloween.
The kids dress up for the celebration.

examples.sr: Ове године ћу се [маскѝрати] у пирата.
examples.en: This year I'll dress up as a pirate.
The children blow on a dandelion.
Young dandelion salad is healthy.
I bought a jar of olives.
I like olives in salad.
I bought an olive-colored jacket.
She has olive skin and dark eyes.
After the fall I have a bruise on my leg.
The blow left him with a bruise.
This pie is too greasy.
I avoid fatty food.
The doctor examines the uterus.

examples.sr: Ултразвук показује да је [ма̏терица] у реду.
examples.en: The ultrasound shows that the uterus is fine.
My native language is Russian.
We learn our native language from our mother.
The wedding was performed by the registrar.
Two witnesses stand next to the registrar.

examples.sr: Где си, [ма̏тори], одавно те нисам видео!
examples.en: Where are you, buddy, I haven't seen you in ages!
My old man works in Germany.
The graduating students are already preparing for the final exam.
As a graduating student, I have to study a lot.
He's a real expert on cars.
Call a repairman to fix the electricity.
The stones are overgrown with moss.
In the forest the ground is covered with moss.
Our tomcat sleeps in the armchair.
The neighbors' tomcat keeps coming into the yard.
Take the tongs and turn the meat.
I removed the splinter with tweezers.
The girl wears a red bow.
The gift is tied with a bow.
I dream of a house by the sea.

examples.sr: Још као дете [ма̏штала] сам да будем астронаут.
examples.en: Even as a child I dreamed of becoming an astronaut.

note: For dreams in sleep, only «сањати» is used.

examples.en: She is a very imaginative girl.
That is an inventive gift.
He worked in a stone quarry.
The old quarry is closed.

note: Of Turkish origin; usually a small working.

examples.en: A lot of mayonnaise goes into Russian salad.
There's no more mayonnaise in the fridge.
I seasoned the sausage with marjoram.
Add a little marjoram to the soup.

examples.sr: Чај од [ма̏јчине ду̀шице] помаже код кашља.
examples.en: Thyme tea helps with a cough.
Thyme goes into fish dishes too.
He has a smaller problem than you.
I need a smaller suitcase.
Her stepmother is very kind.

examples.sr: Дете је живело са оцем и [ма̏ћехо̄м].
examples.en: The child lived with his father and stepmother.
The child sleeps with a teddy bear.
Buy me a teddy bear and a bunny.
Meditation before bed helps me.
Every morning I meditate for ten minutes.
Grandma makes honey rakija for the holidays.

examples.sr: Волим [медо̀вачу], јер је блага и слатка.
examples.en: I like honey rakija because it's smooth and sweet.
There are a lot of jellyfish on the beach.
A jellyfish stung me.
Small appetizers are served with rakija.
The waiter brought a plate of appetizers.
He is grandma's favorite.
The cat is the favorite of the whole family.
The youngest daughter is daddy's favorite.

examples.sr: Као [мѐзимица] могла је све да тражи.
examples.en: As the favorite, she could ask for anything.

note: A favorite, usually the youngest child.

examples.en: In the morning we had mekike with cheese.
Mekika is made from yeast dough.
Autumn throws me into melancholy.
I fall into melancholy when it rains.
We have lunch in the school cafeteria.
The student cafeteria is cheap.
The waiter brought us the menu.

examples.sr: У овом ресторану је [мѐнӣ] и на енглеском.
examples.en: This restaurant has a menu in English too.

note: Masculine; spelled the same as «мени» - to me.

examples.sr: Доктор је питао када је била последња [менструа̀ција].
examples.en: The doctor asked when her last period was.
Pain during menstruation is normal.

note: Colloquially: «добила сам» - I've got my period.

examples.en: Where is the nearest exchange office?

examples.sr: У [мѐнјачници] сам променила евре у динаре.
examples.en: At the exchange office I changed euros into dinars.

note: You can also pay bills at an exchange office.

examples.sr: Пити кафу на тераси је прави [мѐра̄к].
examples.en: Drinking coffee on the terrace is pure bliss.
I do it for the pleasure of it.

note: Of Turkish origin; «по мом мераку» - the way I like it.

examples.en: The ladder is next to the garage.
He climbed onto the roof by the ladder.

note: Plural only: «мердевине су старе» - the ladder is old.

examples.en: Measuring blood pressure takes a minute.

examples.sr: Лекар је урадио [ме̏ре̄ње] шећера у крви.
examples.en: The doctor measured his blood sugar.

examples.sr: Под у холу је од белог [мѐрмера].
examples.en: The floor in the hall is white marble.
The monument is made of marble.
I buy meat at the butcher shop.
The butcher shop is closed on Sundays.
We walked in the moonlight by the sea.
Moonlight ripples on the water.
This bracelet is made of brass.
The faucet is made of brass.
We knead the bread every morning.
Grandma kneaded the dough skillfully.
There will be patches of fog in the morning.
Tomorrow there will be rain in places.
Last night I saw a meteor in the sky.
A shooting star is actually a meteor.
Sweep the yard with a broom.
The witch flies on a broomstick.
The child has a bladder infection.
He was blowing bubbles from soapy water.
The little bear cub is looking for honey.
A bear cub was born at the zoo.
Give me a stirrer for the coffee.
Concrete is made in a mixer.

examples.sr: Наш пас је [меша́нац], али веома паметан.
examples.en: Our dog is a mutt, but very smart.

examples.sr: Узели смо [меша́нца] из склоништа за псе.
examples.en: We adopted a mixed-breed dog from the dog shelter.

note: Said of a person, it is rude.

examples.en: I change euros at the exchange office.
The exchange office is open until eight.
The roads are closed because of the blizzard.
There's a heavy blizzard outside.
You forgot to turn on your turn signal.
Turn on the blinker before turning.
A migraine has been tormenting me for two days.
My aunt suffers from migraines.
The doctor prescribed her a back brace.
Grandma wore a corset under her dress.

note: Both a woman's and a medical corset: «ставити мидер» - to put on a corset.

examples.en: Heat up lunch in the microwave.
The new microwave has a grill.
Beat the eggs with a mixer.
We bought a new mixer.
The ants were crawling straight toward me.
A little spider is crawling along the wall.
The cat loves being petted.

examples.sr: У њеним речима било је много [мѝловања].
examples.en: There was a lot of tenderness in her words.
He asked the judge for mercy.
Compassion is an important human virtue.
There are yellow mimosas in the vase.
She was selling mimosas at the market.
The body needs minerals.
Water contains important minerals.
He works for minimum wage.
It's hard to live on minimum wage.
A mortar is an infantry weapon.
The soldiers set up a mortar on the hill.
Mom gave me gold earrings.
One of my earrings fell off.

meanings: to put up with, to accept
forms: мирим се, мире се; pf. помирити се

examples.en: They always make up quickly.

examples.sr: Не могу да се [ми̏рим] са неправдом.
examples.en: I can't put up with injustice.
The soup is seasoned with dill.
Cucumbers with dill are excellent.
They are a peace-loving people.
He is a quiet, peaceful man.
The strip removes blackheads from the nose.
I have a lot of blackheads on my forehead.
I remove makeup with micellar water.
I bought a bottle of micellar water.
There is little tinsel on the tree.
Kids love to hang tinsel.
The bride is in a white wedding dress.
The wedding guests came to fetch the bride.
The newlyweds arrived at the church.
Everyone toasted the newlyweds.
The tea is already lukewarm.
The audience gave a lukewarm applause.

note: Of a person: indecisive; of a reaction: lukewarm.

examples.en: It's not nice to beat children.
The wind is banging on the windows.

note: Colloquial; can also be said of the wind.

examples.en: You have to know the multiplication table by heart.
Today we're doing multiplication of two-digit numbers.
The word is in the plural.
What is the plural of the word for "road"?
When you multiply by zero, you get zero.
We learned to multiply two-digit numbers.

examples.sr: Усне су му биле [мо̏дре] од хладноће.
examples.en: His lips were blue from the cold.
He has bluish patches on his legs.
Leather loafers go with a blazer.
I couldn't find loafers in my size.
The doctor ordered a urine test for me.
The urine sample is taken to the laboratory.
The painter is painting the walls blue.
We made an arrangement with the painter.
- Thanks for the coffee! - You're welcome.
A kilo of tomatoes, please.
- What's your name? - Pardon?

note: With a rising intonation it means «what?»; on the phone, «I'm listening».
tips: More than «please»: a reply when you are called or on the phone («Молим?» - yes, speaking), asking someone to repeat («Молим?» - pardon?), a request «Молим те…», and for emphasis «Као Бога те молим» - I beg you.

examples.en: The price includes installation of the kitchen.
Assembling the wardrobe takes two hours.
The neighbor has a fat pug.
The pug snores when it sleeps.
A nightmare tormented me last night.
This exam is a real nightmare for me.

note: The plural «море» (ноћне море) is spelled like «море» - sea.

examples.en: He is a moral person.
I don't think that is moral.
Ships pass through a narrow strait.
The Bosphorus is a famous strait.
Give me 200 grams of mortadella.
A mortadella sandwich is my snack.
Grandma tills the garden with a hoe.
Bring me the hoe from the shed.
We take the expressway to Niš.
There are no cyclists on the expressway.

note: A road only for motor vehicles; not the same as «аутопут».

examples.en: Moths have appeared in the wardrobe.
Lavender repels moths.
Don't crumble bread all over the table.
Grandma is crushing walnuts for the cake.
Don't be a grouch, smile.

examples.sr: Комшија је [мр̏гуд] и никог не поздравља.
examples.en: The neighbor is a grump and greets nobody.
Today I got hit by the blues.
Out of sheer reluctance I'm doing nothing.
On Fridays I don't eat anything non-fasting.
For the slava there is always a non-fasting meal.
The wind is tangling my hair.
Don't mess up my plans.
Shoo, get out of here, cat!
Grandpa yelled, "Shoo, get out of the garden!"

note: Colloquial; used to drive animals away, rude to a person.

forms: мрштим се, мрште се; pf. намрштити се

examples.en: Why are you frowning?
He frowns when he's thinking.
He keeps hitting on the waitress.
Don't hit on my girlfriend!

examples.sr: Не буди [мудри̏јаш], знам и ја како се то ради.
examples.en: Don't be a smart aleck, I know how it's done too.
Every class has its own know-it-all.

note: Ironic: someone who thinks he is wiser than everyone.

examples.en: Cows are mooing in the pasture.
The calf is mooing because it is looking for its mother.
The cops came and dispersed the crowd.

examples.sr: Сви знају да [му̏рија] стоји код моста.
examples.en: Everyone knows the cops stand by the bridge.
The child is all smeared with chocolate.
Do I have anything smeared around my mouth?
Moussaka is baked in the oven.

examples.sr: Мајка прави [муса̀ку] од кромпира и меленог меса.
examples.en: Mom makes moussaka from potatoes and ground meat.

note: The Serbian version with potatoes, not the Greek one with eggplant.

examples.en: We have red geraniums on the balcony.
Geraniums love the sun.
The water in the river is murky.

examples.sr: Има неких [му̀тних] послова у тој фирми.
examples.en: There is some shady business going on in that company.
I have a feeling you're up to something.
Don't muddy the water.
A fly is flying around the room.
Don't make a mountain out of a molehill.
Don't pick the fly agaric, it's poisonous!
There is a red fly agaric in the picture.
The child stutters when he is excited.
Out of nerves he started to stutter.
I get nauseous from driving.
This medicine causes nausea.

examples.sr: Дај [му̀штулук], дошао сам да ти јавим добру вест!
examples.en: You owe me a reward, I came to tell you good news!

examples.sr: Тражио је [му̀штулук] јер је први јавио да је положила испит.
examples.en: He demanded a reward because he was the first to report that she had passed the exam.

note: From Turkish; a kind of tip for delivering joyful news.

meanings: mućkalica (meat stew with peppers and vegetables)

examples.en: We're having mućkalica for lunch.
Mućkalica is served in a pot.
Don't smack when you eat!
The little one smacks while eating soup.
I'm going shopping on Saturday.
The weekly shopping is expensive.

note: «ићи у набавку» - to go grocery shopping.

examples.en: She draped a scarf over her shoulders.
He put on a couple of kilos.
The navigation doesn't work in the tunnel.

examples.sr: Угасила сам [навига̀цију] и питала за пут.
examples.en: I turned off the navigation and asked for directions.

related.en: to navigate, to guide along a route

examples.en: Who do you root for?
The whole family roots for the same team.

note: «навијати за» + acc., and not only in sports.

examples.en: The fans sang through the whole match.
He is the biggest Red Star fan.

related.en: to root, to be a fan

examples.en: Put the quote in quotation marks.
Open the quotation marks before the quote.
The nut came loose.
I need a nut for this bolt.

forms: навучем се, навуку се; impf. навлачити се

examples.sr: Он се [наву̀као] на игре на срећу.
examples.en: He got hooked on gambling.
Don't get hooked on cigarettes.

note: Used with «на» + acc.: «навући се на игре».

examples.sr: Он је [на́гао] човек, брзо се наљути.
examples.en: He is a hot-tempered man, he gets angry quickly.
Don't make hasty decisions.
A bat hangs upside down.
He dove into the pool headfirst.
He began to hint at changes.
The clouds foreshadow rain.
She is gifted at music.
That boy is gifted in math.
The poet sought inspiration in nature.
She worked without inspiration.
The car stopped under the overpass.
Cross to the other side over the overpass.

examples.sr: Који [на́дев] желиш у питу - сир или месо?
examples.en: Which filling do you want in the pie - cheese or meat?
The best filling is the one with sour cherries.
Grandma will outlive us all.
He outlived his son.
My upper arm hurts.
The upper arm muscles are strong.

note: The part from the shoulder joint to the elbow; «раме» is the shoulder.

examples.sr: Није био [на̀дмен] иако је био богат.
examples.en: He wasn't arrogant even though he was rich.
She had a haughty look.
Ask your superior.
I told that to my superior.

note: An adjective used as a noun.

examples.en: We have to blow up balloons for the birthday.
He pumped up the bicycle tire.

examples.sr: Дао ми је [на̏знаку] да му се свиђам.
examples.en: He gave me a hint that he likes me.
There is no sign of improvement.

examples.sr: Деца су се [наи̏зменично] љуљала на љуљашци.
examples.en: The children took turns on the swing.

examples.sr: Возимо [наи̏зменично] једну недељу ја, једну ти.
examples.en: We take turns driving: one week me, one week you.
The thing is, the decision has already been made.
I was late; the thing is, the bus was canceled.
This building is ugly.
What an ugly design!
He came home tipsy.
She is a little tipsy, but cheerful.
Don't make the picture crooked when you hang it.
He tilted his head and listens.
Gamzigrad is a famous archaeological site.
A new oil deposit has been discovered.
Turn left at the traffic light.
He looked left and right.

note: Written as one word: «налево - надесно» (left - right).

examples.sr: Добила сам [налѐпницу] за боравак у пасошу.
examples.en: I got a residence sticker in my passport.

examples.sr: На флаши је стајала [налѐпница] са ценом.
examples.en: There was a sticker with the price on the bottle.
The director ordered an urgent inspection.

examples.sr: Суд му је [на̀ложио] да плати штету.
examples.en: The court ordered him to pay damages.
He got plastered and forgot all his problems.
Don't get plastered before work.

related.en: to lap up, to drink greedily

examples.en: The seller completely fooled us.
I won't let them fool me.
I bought a cheese spread.
Kids love chocolate spread.
